question.prompt: Given \(\triangle ABC\cong\triangle DEF\) and \(AB=5\), what is the length of \(DE\)? (The vertices correspond as \(A\leftrightarrow D\), \(B\leftrightarrow E\), and \(C\leftrightarrow F\).)

solutions.explanation: Corresponding sides of congruent triangles are equal. Since \(AB\) and \(DE\) are corresponding sides, \(DE=AB=5\).
solutions.title: Equal corresponding sides
